config.notes: TAFE NSW (VET + higher education). Page kinds: international course pages (www.tafensw.edu.au/international/courses/<slug>--<code>), international package pages (/international/package/<slug>--<id>, two-course pathways), domestic course pages (/course-areas/.../courses/<slug>--<code>-01, no international data), credittransfer.tafensw.edu.au pages and a few general pages. Stored text carries: "Course code: X | CRICOS Code: Y", "Course fee $A - $B AUD" (WHOLE-COURSE range, not annual: never read as fee), "Duration N years". The 2026/2027 "Starting dates, course fees and locations" tab and the entry-requirements tab are filled in the browser, so no start months, campus or IELTS are in the stored text. Central sources: intakes https://www.tafensw.edu.au/international/courses/academic-calendar/certificate-and-diploma (Term 1 Feb, Term 2 April*, Term 3 July, Term 4 September*/October; *some courses only) and https://www.tafensw.edu.au/international/courses/academic-calendar/higher-education (Semester 1 Feb, Semester 2 July); English: https://www.tafensw.edu.au/international/apply/entry-requirements (rule in a linked PDF). Only duration is read by pattern.
